title: Seeing the Hudson
subtitle: Two shores. One river. Different views.
author: Thomas Hagos

pairs.title: One bridge. Two frames.

nj.view: Bridge view from the cliff-top park

pair_line_meaning: Editorial connection between selected public sites; not a walking route, viewing direction, visibility ray or verified mutual sightline.
